北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 -3℃，记得多穿暖和些哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and cold, feels like -3℃. Dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪今天阴天，气温 15℃，体感舒适，记得带伞哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy today, 15℃. Feels comfy, bring an umbrella!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海雾气浓，注意出行安全，多穿件衣服别着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy, travel safely. Wear an extra layer to stay warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，体感 24℃。湿度高，记得补水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and feels like 24℃. High humidity, stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗暖和，体感 22℃。湿度大，注意清爽穿搭。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and warm, feels like 22℃. High humidity, dress light!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，气温 14℃。风力 3级，出门添件外套哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, 14℃. With 3级 wind, grab a jacket when you go out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 -1℃，风力 4级，请务必多穿防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like -1℃ with 4级 wind. Please dress very warmly and windproof.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 13℃。注意保暖，别着凉啦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 13℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 2℃，北风 3级，出行注意保暖防滑。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like 2℃ with 3级 north wind. Stay warm and careful on the road.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴冷，湿度 100%，体感 0℃。注意保暖防潮哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and cold, 100% humidity, feels like 0℃. Stay warm and dry.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 10℃，风力 3级。出门添件衣服哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 10℃ with 3级 wind. Grab an extra layer when you go out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天晴但极冷，体感 -18℃！务必超级保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but extremely cold, feels like -18℃! Dress super warmly.
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -8℃。天气寒冷，注意防寒保暖哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like -8℃. It's cold, keep warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，记得添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 10℃. Big temperature difference, add clothes in morning/evening.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，气温 18℃，湿度大。出行注意安全！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, 18℃, high humidity. Travel safely!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，体感 -8℃，风力 4级。务必穿厚实些！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cold, feels like -8℃ with 4级 wind. Dress very warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感 -10℃，风力 4级。注意防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and cold, feels like -10℃ with 4级 wind. Stay windproof and warm.
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
